heading: Atypical path? I'd say well typed.

law.title: Life as a lawyer
law.text: Five years of law in Brazil — labor, employment, business. Litigation, negotiation, sensitive contracts. That's where I learned rigor, argumentation, and how to hold my ground under pressure.

france.title: France, out of curiosity
france.text: A master's in Human Rights Law in Strasbourg, then life settling in — the city, love, a language you slowly make your own. I came for a stay, I stayed for good.

firstCode.title: Changing everything
firstCode.text: Country, language, then career. First bootcamp, first lines of JavaScript. What I thought I'd explore out of curiosity, I never wanted to leave.

cda.title: Finding my footing
cda.text: Full stack developer program: front-end, back-end, databases, security, testing. Capstone project defended before a panel, then an internship at a Parisian startup on PHP/Laravel in Agile.

mainframe.title: The mainframe
mainframe.text: COBOL, z/OS, JCL, DB2, CICS — ten intensive weeks at M2i. A strict framework where every line counts. I found something familiar from law: rigor, traceability, rules that hold over time.

now.title: And now
now.text: First contract as a mainframe consultant. Between assignments, I keep learning — C#, OOP, new frameworks. Languages change, curiosity stays.

approach.title: approach
approach.text: I see every new programming language as an opportunity, not a barrier. From TypeScript to COBOL — every environment has its own logic, and I adapt. My work is driven by rigor, clean code, and a deep understanding of the business context.

beyondCode.title: beyond code
beyondCode.text: Outside of development, I love cinema, running, dogs, and cooking. These passions keep me balanced and continuously inspired.
